title: Deco BE65 firmware contains a cryptographic weakness in the local web-management authentication flow… (CVE-2026-91139)
description: The Deco BE65 firmware has a cryptographic weakness in its local web-management authentication due to the use of a 512-bit RSA key, which is considered insufficiently secure. This weakness occurs at the /login?form=auth endpoint, which exposes the RSA public key and a sequence value. Exploiting this flaw could compromise the cryptographic protections of the local authentication traffic, potentially allowing unauthorized access.
